$comment: Rung 3 run ledger row schema (R3-L3). One JSON object per line in rung3-run-log/R3-L3-grades.jsonl. Append-only. The coordinator commits the ledger after each task; scorers never write it. A row with test_row=true is the schema-proof row only and is never counted as a grade. Timestamps are ISO 8601 with timezone. keyfile_sha256 is the sha256 of the frozen key file the scorer verified. The field is named keyfile_sha256 (not key_hash) because the repo secret-scan flags a literal key_hash field next to a 64-hex value as a generic API key; the value is still the full key-file sha256. evidence_manifest_hash is the sha256 from the evidence manifest for the task.

evidence_manifest_hash.description: sha256 from the task evidence manifest, or TEST for the schema-proof row
